title: Megan Thee Stallion Returns to ‘Love Island USA’ for Season 8: ‘Now That’s How You Make an Entrance’
summary: The Houston Hottie previously appeared on season seven of the reality dating show.
contentText:
Following the Casa Amor fallout, Megan Thee Stallion has entered the villa. The Houston Hottie returned to Love Island USA on Sunday (June 28) with a surprise guest appearance for season eight.

Megan previously made the trip to Fiji in last year’s season seven, and she’s back to set the cast straight. The “WAP” rapper had jaws dropping on set as she pulled up in a purple thong bikini, pearls and a pink wig.

MTS had the honor of introducing a pair of bombshells to the cast, as Amora Cachee Robinson and Carl Schmidt returned to the villa.

“Now that’s how you make an entrance!” Megan shouted after seeing the shocking reaction to the additions from the cast.

@loveislandusa “Now that’s how you make an entrance” – @Megan Thee Stallion ✨ #LoveIslandUSA

♬ original sound – Love Island USA

Before revealing the newest villa guests, Megan Thee Stallion hosted the Hot Girl Bakery challenge, which saw things get messy while serving up some cake. One scene showed Megan putting KC on blast for his treatment of fellow cast member Aniya. “You don’t remember nothing that happened at Casa?” she snarkily replied to KC.

The 31-year-old is a massive Love Island USA fan. Megan’s debut in the reality dating show came in season seven, during which she introduced contestants TJ Palma and Andreina Santos and hosted the Build a Bombshell challenge.

The Houston Hottie took advantage of the opportunity by having the cast model pieces from her Hot Girl Summer swimwear line. She even made a cameo in the Love Island: Beyond the Villa spin-off.

Last week, Megan Thee Stallion told fans on social media that she’s currently working on securing a “big budget” for her anticipated Act III album. Meg’s last LP arrived in 2024 with her self-titled Megan album, which debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200.
